'''Kilit Leader''' was the callsign of a male [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Kilit Squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] he led the squadron during the attack on the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Aegis Base]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|Eve of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref>
